      • normalizeVersionable

        protected com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle normalizeVersionable​(org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource versionable)
                                                               throws IllegalArgumentException
        If the versionable is a CoreConstants.TYPE_VERSIONABLE it is returned, else we check whether it has a versionable CoreConstants.CONTENT_NODE and return that, otherwise we throw up as this is an invalid argument.
        Returns:
        a ResourceHandle that is valid and is versionable
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if {versionable} doesn't denote a valid versionable

        Description copied from interface: PlatformVersionsService
        Puts the latest content of a couple of documents into the release. We automatically VersionManager.checkpoint(String) each versionables if it was modified, and use the latest version of it.

        Caution: since this may do a checkpoint, it needs a clean resolver before calling.

        Specified by:
        activate in interface PlatformVersionsService
        Parameters:
        releaseKey - a release number or null for the PlatformVersionsService.getDefaultRelease(Resource).
        versionables - a number of versionables which are possibly checkpointed and then activated simultaneously
        Returns:
        information about the activation
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException
        ReleaseChangeFailedException

public @NotNull PlatformVersionsService.ActivationResult activate​(@Nullable

        Description copied from interface: PlatformVersionsService
        Puts the latest content (or a specified version) of the document into the release. If no version is given, we automatically VersionManager.checkpoint(String) the versionable if it was modified, and use the latest version of it.

        Caution: since this may do a checkpoint, it needs a clean resolver before calling.

        Specified by:
        activate in interface PlatformVersionsService
        Parameters:
        releaseKey - a release number or null for the PlatformVersionsService.getDefaultRelease(Resource).
        rawVersionable - the path to a versionable. In case of the "activation" of a deletion, this can be NonExistingResource. In this case we use the path to find it in the release.
        versionUuid - optionally, a previous version of the document that is
        Returns:
        information about the activation
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException

      • activateSingle

        @Nullable
protected @Nullable org.apache.commons.lang3.tuple.Pair<ReleasedVersionable,​Supplier<PlatformVersionsService.ActivationResult>> activateSingle​(@Nullable
                                                                                                                                                     @Nullable String releaseKey,
                                                                                                                                                     @NotNull

                                                                                                                                                     javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                                                                                                                                     StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException,
                                                                                                                                                     ReleaseChangeFailedException
        Returns a ReleasedVersionable that should be fed to StagingReleaseManager.updateRelease(Release, List) and a function that updates an PlatformVersionsService.ActivationResult afterwards. The reason these are separated is that all versionables that are activated should put into one updateRelease to have them all available when the replication searches for references, but there is code to update the result afterwards.
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException
        ReleaseChangeFailedException

      • revert

        @NotNull
public @NotNull PlatformVersionsService.ActivationResult revert​(@NotNull
                                                                @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver resolver,
                                                                @Nullable
                                                                @Nullable String releaseKey,
                                                                @NotNull
                                                                @NotNull List<String> versionablePaths)
                                                         throws org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException,
                                                                javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                                                StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException,
                                                                ReleaseChangeFailedException
        Description copied from interface: PlatformVersionsService
        Reverts a number of versionables to the state they were in the previous release (in the sense of ReleaseNumberCreator.COMPARATOR_RELEASES). If there is no previous release, this deletes the versionable from the content (the "previous release" counting as empty in this case).
        Specified by:
        revert in interface PlatformVersionsService
        Parameters:
        resolver - a resolver we can use
        releaseKey - a release number or null for the PlatformVersionsService.getDefaultRelease(Resource).
        versionablePaths - list of paths to versionables to revert. We use paths instead of resources since they might not exist in the workspace (if moved or deleted) nor in the StagingResolver (if deactivated)
        Returns:
        information about the activation
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException
        ReleaseChangeFailedException

        public void purgeVersions​(@NotNull
                          @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource rawVersionable)

        Description copied from interface: PlatformVersionsService
        Returns a ResourceFilter that accepts resources contained in a release. Outside of the release root it just takes the current contet.
        Specified by:
        releaseAsResourceFilter in interface PlatformVersionsService
        Parameters:
        resourceInRelease - some resource below a release root, used to find the release root
        releaseKey - a release number or null for the PlatformVersionsService.getDefaultRelease(Resource).
        releaseMapper - a ReleaseMapper that determines what is taken from the release, and what from the current content
        additionalFilter - a resource filter that has additionally be matched for the resource within the release (and is executed with the Staging Resolver). If null, we just use ResourceFilter.ALL.
        Returns:
        a ResourceFilter that returns true for resources contained in the release
